name: 电影剧照
description: 方向明确的电影布光，柔和高光与细密胶片颗粒营造含蓄叙事感。
rendering_prompt: Shape the image with the tonal depth of motion-picture film photography. Use a clearly directional key light, restrained fill, and natural cast shadows to establish a narrative atmosphere. Coordinate warm and cool tones, soften highlight roll-off, retain shadow detail, and add fine, irregular film grain. Let sharp and defocused areas transition smoothly. Keep materials believable and avoid sharpening halos or excessive lighting effects.
avoid: 塑料皮肤、过度锐化、廉价光晕
difference: 电影剧照靠布光与叙事层次；复古胶片更强调负片响应与日常暖色
tuning: 先明确主光方向，再调冷暖关系，最后少量加颗粒。
